name: Field Doctor-Style Double Chocolate Bar (Low FODMAP)
ingredients:
185 g Almonds (tree nuts)
100 g Organic Brown Rice Syrup
55 g Organic Protein Blend (Pea and Rice)
3 1/2 tbsp Vegan Dark Chocolate (Cocoa Butter, Cocoa Powder, Coconut Sugar)
2 1/2 tbsp Cocoa Powder
1 tbsp Soy Protein Crisps ( soya )
2/3 tsp Himalayan Salt
directions:
1. Prep: Line a small tray/tin (for 8 bars) with baking paper.

2. Mix: Process nuts/seeds if needed, then mix with syrup/binder, protein blend, flavourings and any chocolate/fruit pieces until a sticky dough forms. Warm the syrup slightly if the mix is too stiff.

3. Press: Firmly press into the tin in an even layer. Chill until set (about 1–2 hours, or overnight).

4. Cut: Cut into 8 bars. Keep refrigerated up to a week, or freeze. Inspired by Double Chocolate Bar — gluten-free / Low FODMAP friendly recreation.
